scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm contract:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.lint: composer --working-dir=backend analyse && pnpm --dir frontend lint && node scripts/check-module-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: composer --working-dir=backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm --dir frontend test:e2e
